Self-motivated, details oriented, effectively working across multiple projects under pressure meeting tight release schedules. Extensive knowledge of QA processes, QA methodologies and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Passion for product quality, proven bug detection, regression, and troubleshooting root cause skills. Hands-on experience testing Windows, Linux and Mac OS X operating systems. Expertise in testing web and mobile device applications, and in automation. Exposure to Python. Solid experience testing consumer electronics, computer accessories and software applications, including WLAN networking products, Mobile and Bluetooth wireless devices.
